title: Crown SC 5700 Over-Temperature Light: The Exact Manual Page and Safe Response
summary: A close reading of the SC 5700 operator manual: what the yellow thermometer light proves, what the operator should do, and what the page does not diagnose.
body_markdown:
## Read the icon and the instruction as one unit


The original diagram makes the page locator easier to use: the arrow identifies the thermometer symbol described by Crown, while the evidence card takes the reader to the exact official page that defines it. This avoids a common failure in remote intake—naming a warning from memory while losing the controlling source.


The page uses a yellow indicator for the over-temperature condition. The operational direction is still explicit: park, shut down, and obtain service. The light color should not be treated as a license to finish the shift.
